description: SURFACED by the fz-rh2.17.5.6.9 audit; the .13-BLOCKING half of the original completeness ticket (the orthogonal default-value-form feature was split out to fz-rh2.17.5.6.8.3). A module with two defstruct forms (defmodule M do; defstruct [:a]; defstruct [:b]; end) is accepted with NO diagnostic. Today the divergence is inert (World::module_struct_fields uses .find_map => FIRST wins; StructDefMap::define uses HashMap::insert => LAST wins; the scan is the sole reader so behavior is first-wins). But the moment slice .13 makes the StructDef store authoritative and deletes the scan, a malformed duplicate-defstruct module silently flips first->last with no diagnostic either way. FIX (preferred, one struct per module is the intended grammar): emit a duplicate-defstruct diagnostic at the SECOND defstruct's span when apply_scope_form/publish_struct_def sees a module already carrying a StructDef. Regression test: a two-defstruct module -> diagnostic (not silent first/last). This resolves the semantics BEFORE .13 deletes the scan. Related: fz-rh2.17.5.6.9, fz-rh2.17.5.6.13, fz-rh2.17.5.6.8.3.

comments.text: Folded at c3c26001c. Emits RESOLVE_DUPLICATE_STRUCT at the second defstruct's span when a module already has a StructDef, resolving the first-vs-last silent divergence (old scan find_map=first-wins vs store HashMap::insert=last-wins) BEFORE slice .13 deletes the scan. Adversarial audit found span-only gate robust for literal duplicates but with a macro-same-span silent-overwrite gap; STRENGTHENED at fold to full-StructDef comparison (fields+span, = StructDefMap::define's changed signal): job re-run (byte-identical) stays idempotent (the 19 re-run false-positives do NOT return, confirmed); literal dup (diff span) diagnosed; macro dup with diff fields (same span) now DIAGNOSED not silently overwritten; residual macro dup with identical fields = benign miss (no data loss), untestable until macro-defstruct emission exists. Determinism/keep-first/diagnostic-channel all audit-clean. lib 1267/0/6, matrix 350/11. Follow-ups: fz-rh2.17.5.6.8.4 (confirm macro-defstruct reachability + cover the residual, gates .13). Unblocks .13 (with .11, .8.4).

title: Structs: emit a duplicate-defstruct diagnostic (one struct per module) before the store becomes authoritative
